text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I told Orfevre that a letter 
had arrived from a fan—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Good work. Hand it over to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Written on the envelope were the words "To 
Lady Orfevre." And from the little I could 
see of the stationary, it was written 
mostly in hiragana.
choice_data_list: Could this be a fan letter from a kid?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ……Hm, this writing. Could it be 
that child from back then?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It's a chance encounter.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...! Mommy... where are youuu...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"You there. ...Did you get separated from 
your mother?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Worry not. You only need to wait here with 
me. Her mother will surely arrive soon.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ......Big Sis is...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...However, promise me one thing.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Wipe your tears and look ahead. If you 
wish to stand beside the King, carry 
yourself with bold audacity.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That's all there is to it.
choice_data_list:
Helping a lost kid like that... You're so 
kind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You dare make a fool of me?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Young children are the people who will 
build our future. If I do not guide them, 
what kind of king would I be?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Worship of the King shall one day bring 
revolution to the people. ...Just like 
this child.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—I went to see Orfevre's race for the 
first time... She was so cool, my heart 
was racing the whole time!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Blowing past everyone around you. 
Standing proud and tall, even as you 
crossed the finish line."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just like how she saved me that day... 
Orfevre-san was shining so brilliantly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become strong enough for 
Orfevre-san to acknowledge me too. So... 
next time, even if I get lost, I won't 
cry! Not at all!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Mark my words well. It is precisely 
because of their innocence that their 
emotions are so pure.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I must continue to display my 
strength. ...As the absolute 'King.'
